option_relations.rationale: Intergluteal and sacral hyperhidrosis is a specific type of primary focal hyperhidrosis
Primary focal hyperhidrosis (gluteal region) is equivalent to the leaf label Primary focal hyperhidrosis
Localized infection or intertrigo is not directly related to the symptoms described
Idiopathic localized hyperhidrosis is equivalent to the leaf label Idiopathic localized hyperhidrosis

decisions.rationale: Localized infection or intertrigo is a distinct condition that may present with similar symptoms, but it is not directly related to the other options, and Intertrigo has its own leaf ID B2.1
